lineage: Rust locker with strong code/command overlap with ALPHV/BlackCat (possible rebrand or code reuse); access possibly via Brutus botnet operators
summary: Cicada3301 is a RaaS first observed in June 2024 (affiliate ads on RAMP, first leak post 25 June 2024) targeting mainly SMBs in North America and the UK. Truesec traced one intrusion to valid ScreenConnect credentials used from an IP tied to the Brutus VPN/remote-access brute-force botnet. Its Rust lockers for Windows and ESXi closely mirror BlackCat: embedded credentials drive PsExec propagation, EDRSandBlast tampers with EDR through a vulnerable signed driver, fsutil enables remote symlink evaluation, wevtutil clears logs, bcdedit and shadow-copy deletion inhibit recovery, and ESXi builds force-kill VMs and delete snapshots before ChaCha20 encryption.
uniqueTraits: Initial access with stolen/brute-forced ScreenConnect credentials from Brutus botnet infrastructure
Credentials of the compromised user embedded in the locker and used to run PsExec across the network
BlackCat-identical pre-encryption commands: fsutil SymLinkEvaluation R2L/R2R, MaxMpxCt SMB tweak, wevtutil log clearing, bcdedit recovery disable, iisreset
ESXi build: esxcli force-kill of VMs and vim-cmd snapshot.removeall unless no_vm_ss is set; intermittent encryption >100 MB

chain.procedure: Raises the LanmanServer MaxMpxCt value so SMB can handle heavy PsExec traffic (BlackCat behaviour).

atomics.testName: BlackCat pre-encryption cmds with Lateral Movement
atomics.note: [T1569.002] BlackCat pre-encryption command set (MaxMpxCt change, fsutil symlink evaluation, PsExec propagation).

chain.techniqueName: File and Directory Permissions Modification: Windows
chain.procedure: Uses fsutil behavior set SymLinkEvaluation to enable remote-to-local/remote-to-remote symlinks so redirected files can be encrypted.

atomics.testName: BlackCat pre-encryption cmds with Lateral Movement
atomics.note: [T1569.002] Includes the BlackCat fsutil SymLinkEvaluation command.

chain.techniqueName: Impair Defenses: Clear Windows Event Logs
chain.procedure: Clears all event logs with wevtutil.

atomics.note: [T1685.005] BlackCat full event-log clear via wevtutil.

chain.procedure: Stops IIS with iisreset.exe and terminates backup/recovery services and a hard-coded process list so locked files can be encrypted.

atomics.testName: Windows - iisreset.exe to stop Internet services

chain.procedure: Deletes shadow copies (BlackCat-like method) and uses bcdedit to disable system recovery.

atomics.testName: Windows - Disable Windows Recovery Console Repair

chain.procedure: Stops locally deployed VMs; the ESXi build force-kills running VMs via esxcli and deletes all snapshots with vim-cmd (snapshot.removeall) unless no_vm_ss is passed.

atomics.note: [T1529] Terminates ESXi VMs by killing their processes.

atomics.testName: ESXi - vim-cmd Used to Power Off VMs
atomics.note: [T1529] Powers off ESXi VMs with vim-cmd.

chain.procedure: Rust locker encrypts with ChaCha20 (key protected by RSA), partially encrypting files >100 MB, appending a random extension and a matching ransom note; requires a 0x2C-byte key parameter. Data is posted to a leak site for double extortion.
